visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a woman and a young child standing against a rough brick wall. The background wall features partially visible text reading 'PALE AL... GIN & SPIRITS'. The style is characteristic of 19th-century illustrative wood engraving.
